comments.author: mikufilck
comments.body_html:
I found the exact root cause for the RUAF squad spawn issue.

In the DLL’s GeneratePatrol method, ForceSpawn and IgnoreMaxBots are both set to false. Since the RUAF squad has 4-6 bots, it hits the SPT MaxBots limit (4 per zone) and gets blocked from spawning.

The squad we see from the second raid onwards is actually a Hunt squad, not the patrol one. The actual RUAF Patrol squad never spawns. In GenerateRemnantPatrol, Hunt squads have both ForceSpawn and IgnoreMaxBots set to True, which is why they work fine.

I already tested a fix using dnSpy. Note that you have to use IL instructions to modify it, otherwise it throws an error.
